focus: Final pass: symlink re-check of the duplicate claims, the zero-or-one-finding release gaps, and re-running the five strongest P1 repros

graphEvents.label: Is the .opencode checker a duplicate or the same inode?
f-iter015-007 withdrawn: one inode, not a copy
opencode parity arm compares a file with itself
v4.0.0.4-.10 share one commit touching nothing in scope
Duplication audit needs dev:ino, not readlink
Same dev:ino is the only proof of sameness

label: f-iter015-007 is withdrawn in full: there is no duplicate checker. .opencode/bin is a symlink to ../.skilled/bin, so .opencode/bin/check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs and .skilled/bin/check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs are one inode reached by two paths, which is why both carry 8,227 bytes and md5 c53ec9197387a417addf98ac8dbb41a7; git ls-files -s tracks the .skilled path only. readlink on the file prints nothing because the file is not the symlink - its parent is. The proposed fix, point CHECKER at the canonical path, is a no-op: agent-mirror-sync.yml:57 already resolves to the canonical file. The defect is in the finding, not the workflow, and it is P1 because a P2 entry driving a no-op change costs an implementer a round trip.

The parity gate's required opencode arm compares a file with itself. RUNTIME_MIRRORS declares opencode first with required:true (mirror-sync-verify.cjs:51) against template .opencode/agents/{name}.md, expanded by runtimePaths() at line 285, but .opencode/agents is a symlink to ../.skilled/agents, so canonical and mirror are the same bytes and the arm can only report in-sync. The claude arm (line 52) is the only required arm comparing two distinct files; the codex arm (line 53) is required:false and TOML. Net: one required real comparison across seven shipped runtime trees, which sharpens f-iter015-005 rather than repeating it - that finding counted the list, this one proves a listed entry is inert. Fix: drop opencode to required:false and add pi, whose .pi/agents is a real directory, or keep the row and label it presence-only so the coverage number is not read as three.

Seven release numbers carry one commit that touched nothing in this child's scope. v4.0.0.4 through v4.0.0.10 all tag 4d8f403355, subject chore(system-spec-kit): rebuild the trigger index, and its own diff over .skilled/commands/doctor, .skilled/skills/sk-git and .github/workflows is empty. Focus item 2 answered directly: no release in the gap changed a doctor check, a sk-git script or a workflow in its own commit. The scope-touching work reachable from the tag is a4e543c75a, three sk-git changelog and README lines, and everything else in the window is v4.0.0.11's fix series. Consequence: a path-limited git diff v4.0.0.3..v4.0.0.10 over these clusters is guaranteed empty, so any v4.0.0.4-.10 note citing doctor, git or CI behaviour rides a chore commit and can be reconciled only by reading HEAD.

The duplication audit needs an inode test, not a readlink. Two paths are the same file iff dev+ino match; readlink on a file under a symlinked parent returns empty and reads as a regular file, which is exactly how a false duplicate was filed. A --duplicates mode in agent-roster-mirror-check.cjs that stats both sides and compares dev:ino, plus a readlink -f on every ancestor, turns that check into the thing that produced this correction. Nothing breaks if removed because the mode does not exist today, so the cost is one addition and the payoff is that no future audit can repeat a same-size-equals-copy inference. The mistake prevented is not hypothetical - it is f-iter015-007.

git log -1 <tag> -- <path> is not the tag's commit: it prints the most recent reachable commit touching that path. For the shared tag 4d8f403355 the command returns a4e543c75a instead, so a log -1 shortcut silently reports the wrong commit for every v4.0.0.4-.10 release. git show --stat <commit> -- <path> is the correct probe and correctly printed nothing.

Five P1 repros re-run at HEAD, all confirmed: R1 symlink-engine check over an empty root prints source-missing drift and exits rc=0; R2 a fresh repo resolves hooks to ~/.config/git/hooks; R3 five sk-git suites on disk against one workflow invocation; R4 grep -rln agents-md .github/workflows/ returns nothing with grep-rc=1; R5 RUNTIME_MIRRORS holds exactly three runtime entries at lines 51-53.

A path under a symlinked parent directory is the same inode as its target; readlink on the file proves nothing, and equal byte size or md5 proves sameness only in combination with equal dev:ino. Claiming a copy requires ls -ld on every ancestor plus git ls-files -s on the path.

direction: Treating .opencode/bin/check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs as a duplicate of .skilled/bin/check-agent-mirror-sync.cjs and proposing that CHECKER be repointed at the canonical path
reason: The two paths are one inode: .opencode/bin is a symlink to ../.skilled/bin (verified with ls -ld, md5 and stat ino). agent-mirror-sync.yml:57 already resolves to the canonical file, so the proposed fix is a no-op and the premise of f-iter015-007 does not hold.
